text:
Kai: Found a rubber lobster in the snack cupboard. Who brought this majestic creature? :lobster:
Ruth: That lobster is mine! Long story: a conference swag war I won. It comes with a honk. :trophy:
Leo: Honk? We need a ritual. Every time someone closes a big PR, they must honk the lobster and post a celebration GIF. :party_popper:
Amir: Agreed. Also proposal: lobster gets a tiny throne on the snack shelf and an official title: Chief Honker. :crown:
Kai: Rules draft: 1) Honk only for approved wins (merge-to-main, deploy tagged) 2) Honk video required for remote folks 3) Chief Honker changes weekly, chosen by applause reaction.
Ruth: I endorse. Also can we make a quick Slack emoji of the lobster? Low-effort, high payoff. @SnackBot can you add an emoji?
SnackBot: I can only suggest emoji to admins. Suggested emoji: :red_lobster:. (SnackBot)
Leo: If admins are busy, we'll use the GIF route. Honk GIF + confetti + at-mention. Also winners get temporary nickname "Sir Honksalot" or "Lady Clackington". :laughing:
Amir: Tradition idea: onboarding includes a short clip of the new hire honking the lobster to accept their Slack nickname. Keep it short and awkward. :camera_with_flash:
Kai: Photo evidence rule: no proof = no honors. Also lobster throne must be respected. No dipping lobster in coffee. :no_good:
Ruth: I'll make a tiny sign: "Lobster Throne: do not remove unless you are a Chief Honker." Low-effort print, high dignity.
Leo: Can someone animate a short 2-second honk sound for the notification channel? I volunteer to stitch a sound if we can host it somewhere.
SnackBot: Reminder set: "Lobster throne sign and emoji suggestion" in 3 days. (SnackBot)
Amir: OK ceremony Friday after stand-up? Quick honk parade. Remote folks can upload a 3-second video.
Kai: Friday works. Bringing extra lobster (plastic not real) for backup. May the honks be bold. :lobster: :tada:
